title: Durable HITL Approval Webhook (outbound)
description: State-holding payload this skill's scripts POST to an external workflow dashboard when an ADK LongRunningFunctionTool pauses an invocation for human approval. See references/durable_hitl_patterns.md §2.

ticket_id.description: Stable correlation ID generated by the tool at request time. Must be echoed back verbatim in the resume payload (assets/approval_response_schema.json).

app_name.description: ADK App.name the paused invocation belongs to.

user_id.description: The session's user_id, required to call runner.run_async(...) or /run_sse again.

session_id.description: The session_id the paused invocation is running in.

invocation_id.description: The invocation_id of the run that produced this pause. Required on resume when ResumabilityConfig(is_resumable=True) is set -- omitting it starts a new invocation instead of resuming (see references/adk_graph_hitl_api.md §4).

function_call_id.description: The exact function_call.id ADK assigned to the LongRunningFunctionTool call. Must be echoed back as function_response.id on resume -- not the ticket_id.

tool_name.description: The tool's function name (e.g. 'ask_for_approval'). Used as function_response.name on resume.

hint.description: Human-readable description of what is being asked, rendered by the dashboard/notification UI.

payload.description: Structured context for the dashboard to render (amount, purpose, requester, links). Arbitrary shape -- defined by the calling agent, not this schema.

requested_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the approval was requested.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp after which the resume endpoint must reject a reply as expired. Null/omitted means no expiry (not recommended for production -- see references/durable_hitl_patterns.md §6).

response_url.description: The URL the dashboard should POST its decision to (this skill's scripts/resume_workflow.py --serve endpoint), matching assets/approval_response_schema.json.

signature.description: hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical JSON (sorted keys, this field excluded) of the rest of this payload, keyed by the shared webhook secret. Lets the dashboard verify the request genuinely came from this service.
